name: Compleation
description: The Phyrexian campaign to alter the world of Mirrodin.

timeline.summary: The slow spread becomes an active campaign to compleat Mirrodin, and the Mirrans are overwhelmed.
timeline.quote: The Mirrans fought many battles, but they soon were overwhelmed by the Phyrexian forces.

pages_say.description: The Phyrexian process of transformation into a unified being.
The process that fused stone and metal on Zendikar and in Nahiri.
The Phyrexian campaign to alter the world of Mirrodin.
